mlag.note: Active/active MLAG pair using standard LACP (listed on the datasheet)

stacking.note: No hardware stacking on the datasheet. Arista SWAG (Switch Aggregation Group) can combine switches into one logical system over standard Ethernet links, but per-platform support is not published publicly

verifyNote: SWAG support is not on the datasheet and Arista's platform list is behind a login. If confirmed, set stacking.tech to SWAG and take the member limit and port usage from the platform documentation, not the general 48-switch figure

routing.summary: EOS Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, IS-IS, BGP/MP-BGP, RIPv2, VRRP, VRF, PBR. PIM, VXLAN and EVPN are listed as not yet supported in EOS. Dynamic routing needs the FLX-Lite license (Group 0)

power.summary: Fixed internal AC power supply: 180W (12TH) or 460W (28TNH). The 12TH is fanless; the 28TNH has 2+1 fans

licensing: Base EOS included. Dynamic routing needs FLX-Lite (LIC-FIX-G0-FLX-L, up to 8K routes). Also manageable with CloudVision CUE (subscription)

models.note: Rated to 35C in vertical, under-counter or enclosed mounting. Magnetic mount kit also available
Ordered as CCS-710XP-28TNH-2S-F. Minimum EOS and weight are listed as TBD on the Aug 2026 datasheet
models.verifyNote: The datasheet shows one 95 Mpps value spanning both model columns; it may apply only to the 12TH
